boundaries: Headless native dual-track decode and position progress, no visible first frame or audible first sound.
Main application timeout path is a strategy comparison, not equal-timeout isolation of CDN performance.
Each mode has only two trials per source/profile; no P95, significance, cold-cache or all-video guarantee.
Seek checks target then one second of positive progress, not long post-seek playback.
Exact total and pre-seek/seek cache counts are retained; initial versus sustained phase evidence is from 0.5-second sampled timeline.
No source acquisition time or bridge setup in initial_progress_seconds; bridge_setup_seconds is separate.
Failure, timeout, unknown cache and not-run states are not counted as zero pauses.

native initial_progress_seconds is loadfile to start_seconds+0.1 seconds; it is not the first mathematically positive time-pos. The raw first_positive_progress_seconds phase label refers to this threshold.
The native startup segment covers the entire pre-seek observation, not only initial loading. Sampled phase evidence has 0.5-second cadence, while exact pause counts/durations remain native totals.
Comparison keys remain separate by BV, cache profile, source fingerprint, timeouts and frozen runtime. No medians are combined across these groups.
During a run, attempted counts reflect rows with delivered results. If abruptly interrupted, a planned not_run slot can represent unpersisted in-flight activity; its true attempted state is unknown.
Representation was acquired with highest-quality request 129 and AVC preference; actual q116/q112 are preserved, not claimed as 4K or the highest across all codecs.
Bridge memory snapshot is before bridge close. Outstanding logical reservations alone do not prove a leak; raw negative/missing/invalid counters are retained in audit.
